description: Model Lab configuration for the Gas Ops Knowledge Assistant. activeModelId is the model the live chat API uses for answer generation. Weights are percentages and always sum to 100.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.strengths: Highest answer quality and nuance; strong instruction-following and citation discipline; extended thinking

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.strengths: Near-frontier quality at low latency; reliable grounding and citations; extended thinking

models.name: DeepSeek-R1
models.strengths: Open-weight reasoning model that always shows its chain of thought; strong multi-step logic; slower

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.strengths: Open-weight reasoning model from OpenAI; excellent quality per dollar

models.name: Mistral Large 3
models.strengths: Large open-weight European model; strong multilingual and enterprise instruction-following

models.name: Llama 4 Maverick 17B
models.strengths: Mixture-of-experts open-weight model; very fast and inexpensive; concise answers

models.name: Amazon Nova Pro
models.strengths: AWS first-party balanced model; low latency; deep Bedrock feature support (guardrails, distillation)

models.name: Amazon Nova Micro
models.strengths: Text-only, lowest cost and latency in the catalog; best for simple lookups at very high volume
